About this item

  • COMFORT FOR LONG GAMING SESSIONS – Stay supported through gaming, streaming and desk time with a high back, thick cushioning, lumbar support and headrest pillow designed to reduce pressure during extended sitting.
  • ROCK BACK AND RELAX – Take a break between matches or work sessions with the rocking function (90-125°). Lean back and gently rock when you want to relax, then return to an upright position when it is time to focus.
  • RACING STYLE BUILT FOR YOUR SETUP – Blue PU leather, a high-back racing profile and padded seating give this gaming chair the look of a dedicated gaming setup while keeping the surface easy to wipe clean.
  • STABLE SUPPORT, SMOOTH MOVEMENT – A heavy-duty metal base supports up to 250 lb, while the 360° swivel and smooth-rolling nylon casters make it easy to move between your monitor, desk and gaming setup.
  • SET UP AND START GAMING FAST – Everything needed for assembly is included, with step-by-step instructions and required tools. Most setups can be completed in approximately 10–15 minutes.

Product description

Racing Office Chair: Office chair has fashion upholstery, beautifully designed and thickness padded, fits the sitting position of human thigh that would provided you a comfortable seat.

Leisure Live: Office chair have modern profile offers a professional appearance, add one gaming chair to your workspace. It helps promote a comfortable seated position, which is important when at your desk or in front of the computer for long stretches of time.

Ergonomic Armrests: Office chair have ergonomic design of armrest can help improve your posture and reduce tension in your shoulders and spine.

Lumbar Support: Comfortable Ergonomic gaming office chair with nylon Lumbar Support to provide exceptional support, gives you a better seating experience.

Adjustable Private Custom: Office chair offer is that you can personally adjust height of the chair to match your needs. You can pull out on the control handle, which allows yours to tilt back sit forward, just push the control handle in to prevent it from tilting.

Commercial Gas-lift: Computer chair with extra thickness gas lift, fast up and down, you will feel safety, comfortable and convenient in your live.

Solid & Stable: Office chair have heavy-duty metal base, great stability and mobility. Office chair maximum capacity up to 250 lb, and the base has 2500lbs.

Degree Swivel & Casters: Office chair have swivels degrees for multitasking convenience, and its durable casters allow for smooth-rolling mobility from one area of the office to another again.

Brand new and high quality, luxury racing car style office chair, high back, comfortable arm rests, black metal star base and adjustable height gas-spring, comfortable backrest. This desk chair gives you excellent seating experience while you working or relaxing.

Feature

Super easy to install, office chair can be set up in about 10-15mins.

360 degree swivel wheel and chair can be more flexible in working station.

Gaming chair with tilt lock, tension control.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

5 out of 5 stars
Comfortable, stylish, and great value for the price!
I’ve had this chair for a few days now, and I’m really impressed with how much comfort and quality you get for the price. The setup was easily understood based on the instructions & it took me about 20–30 minutes. Once assembled, it looks sleek and felt sturdy. The functionality is great for a basic gaming / office chair & it is very easy to move around unlike others that you have to drag with you. The lumbar support & adjustable recline are perfect for long work or gaming sessions. The padding is firm but not too stiff, and the armrests sit at a good height. I use it daily in my office for video editing & gaming, and it’s made a big difference in my posture & comfort. Overall, this is a solid, budget-friendly chair that doesn’t feel cheap. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a stylish, ergonomic upgrade without breaking the bank.

    Its much better than nothing and much cheaper than higher quality chairs
    Reviewed in the United States on July 30, 2023
    Color: WhiteStyle: Style1
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I'm a big believer in "you get what you pay for" and I usually advise to save up, make one purchase, make one investment and don't worry about it for a few years. But something about this chair's value really scales, especially if you can grab it on sale. I got mine in white for $75 including tax and shipping. Many quality gaming chairs cost hundreds of dollars. There a handful of cheap office chairs you can snag for $60. This chair compared to one of those generic office chair is worth the extra $15. If you're looking at this chair for $90 or higher, then the former statement is true (save up). Anyway. I've had this chair for a day now and it isn't perfect. I'll go over what I like and what I don't like.

    Appearance: It looks nice. Doesn't look or feel too cheap. The base is metal with plastic feet. Many chairs have plastic base with plastic feet.+1pt

    Functionality: This chair has a handful of features--

    You can adjust the height. +1pt

    But it only has about a 3in range -1pt

    It has a lock to let you remain upright and can be unlocked so you can recline back. +1pt

    It does NOT have a way to lock in the reclined position. -1pt

    Comfort: This chair is pretty comfy. It has a removable/adjustable head pillow and a removable/adjustable lumbar pillow as well. +1pt

    It is a little stiff. Some people may like that. It also may break it after a while. I've only had it one day so I will update if something new develops. The chair has a *mostly* comfortable width to me. It measures 19" for arm to arm. But it has this little "cushion" that tries to contour your legs that makes it a little uncomfortable to sit with my legs spread even a little. I have to keep my knees closer together than I normally would to keep the "cushion" from digging into the side of my legs. Because of this, there is really only about 16" of room for your butt or the sides of your thighs. I'm about 5'10" Male 215lbs size 38 pants XL shirt. I think I am at the cusp of being able to comfortably sit in this. It was not made with larger people in mind. It does state a 250lb weight limit while we're on the topic. -1pt

    Assembly: I've assembled several office chairs before and this process was similar and just as easy. +1pt

    If you aren't experienced or if you struggle with Ikea stuff, you may find it difficult. The hardware that they include is kinda junk. If you have the luxury of using your own hardware (or hand tools at least), I would highly recommend it. I had one bolt that had really junky threads from the factory and I couldn't do much about it, just had to cross thread it and tighten it the best I could. I had another bolt that stripped and the thread never would grab. Luckily there was one extra included in the packaging and I ended up being able to tighten it without cross threading. I think I got lucky. 90% of the assembly was smooth sailing and the few snags that arose, I knew exactly what to do. Again, if you aren't experienced with this, it could easily turn into a headache and a return to amazon over poor quality hardware

    Its much better than nothing and much cheaper than higher quality chairs
    Reviewed in the United States on July 30, 2023
    Color: WhiteStyle: Style1
    Verified Purchase

    I'm a big believer in "you get what you pay for" and I usually advise to save up, make one purchase, make one investment and don't worry about it for a few years. But something about this chair's value really scales, especially if you can grab it on sale. I got mine in white for $75 including tax and shipping. Many quality gaming chairs cost hundreds of dollars. There a handful of cheap office chairs you can snag for $60. This chair compared to one of those generic office chair is worth the extra $15. If you're looking at this chair for $90 or higher, then the former statement is true (save up). Anyway. I've had this chair for a day now and it isn't perfect. I'll go over what I like and what I don't like.

    Appearance: It looks nice. Doesn't look or feel too cheap. The base is metal with plastic feet. Many chairs have plastic base with plastic feet.+1pt

    Functionality: This chair has a handful of features--

    You can adjust the height. +1pt

    But it only has about a 3in range -1pt

    It has a lock to let you remain upright and can be unlocked so you can recline back. +1pt

    It does NOT have a way to lock in the reclined position. -1pt

    Comfort: This chair is pretty comfy. It has a removable/adjustable head pillow and a removable/adjustable lumbar pillow as well. +1pt

    It is a little stiff. Some people may like that. It also may break it after a while. I've only had it one day so I will update if something new develops. The chair has a *mostly* comfortable width to me. It measures 19" for arm to arm. But it has this little "cushion" that tries to contour your legs that makes it a little uncomfortable to sit with my legs spread even a little. I have to keep my knees closer together than I normally would to keep the "cushion" from digging into the side of my legs. Because of this, there is really only about 16" of room for your butt or the sides of your thighs. I'm about 5'10" Male 215lbs size 38 pants XL shirt. I think I am at the cusp of being able to comfortably sit in this. It was not made with larger people in mind. It does state a 250lb weight limit while we're on the topic. -1pt

    Assembly: I've assembled several office chairs before and this process was similar and just as easy. +1pt

    If you aren't experienced or if you struggle with Ikea stuff, you may find it difficult. The hardware that they include is kinda junk. If you have the luxury of using your own hardware (or hand tools at least), I would highly recommend it. I had one bolt that had really junky threads from the factory and I couldn't do much about it, just had to cross thread it and tighten it the best I could. I had another bolt that stripped and the thread never would grab. Luckily there was one extra included in the packaging and I ended up being able to tighten it without cross threading. I think I got lucky. 90% of the assembly was smooth sailing and the few snags that arose, I knew exactly what to do. Again, if you aren't experienced with this, it could easily turn into a headache and a return to amazon over poor quality hardware

    At roughly a year-ish of ownership.

    It became my main office/computer chair, replacing a pretty standard office chair originally bought at staples/office depot. Work from home so in this chair a pretty consistent amount of time, beyond leisure time/work outside of this.

    Pro's - pretty durable. I'd say its gotten its fair share of wear and tear and it's still holding pretty well. No rips that I see, arm supports still holding strong, can lean back and shift the chair up/down with no issues. Head rest isn't half bad, same with the included lower lumbar support.

    (Sort of) Con's - It's a little smaller width wise than I'd realize. The previous staples office chair wasn't that expensive, but it had a few extra inches in the seat so it felt a bit more leisurely than this. It's not terrible, but check the width dimensions just to be sure.

    The seat cushion you sit on isn't much of a 'cushion' in the sense that it's soft or has any 'give' when you sit, its pretty solid. The good of this means it kept its form over time - the bad is it isn't very comfortable after extended periods; depends what you're expecting. This sturdiness also translates to the occasional bit of not so comfortable sitting with the family jewels.

    I bought it the intent to see if this style of chair is worth it, considering some of the competitors want $500 for these. It's good for the price point, but with some shortcomings so to me, it was worth it over spending $500 and having the same complaints.

About this Item

  • COMFORT FOR LONG GAMING SESSIONS – Stay supported through gaming, streaming and desk time with a high back, thick cushioning, lumbar support and headrest pillow designed to reduce pressure during extended sitting.
  • ROCK BACK AND RELAX – Take a break between matches or work sessions with the rocking function (90-125°). Lean back and gently rock when you want to relax, then return to an upright position when it is time to focus.
  • RACING STYLE BUILT FOR YOUR SETUP – Blue PU leather, a high-back racing profile and padded seating give this gaming chair the look of a dedicated gaming setup while keeping the surface easy to wipe clean.
  • STABLE SUPPORT, SMOOTH MOVEMENT – A heavy-duty metal base supports up to 250 lb, while the 360° swivel and smooth-rolling nylon casters make it easy to move between your monitor, desk and gaming setup.
  • SET UP AND START GAMING FAST – Everything needed for assembly is included, with step-by-step instructions and required tools. Most setups can be completed in approximately 10–15 minutes.

Product Description

Built for gaming, work and study, this high-back PU leather chair combines a racing-inspired look with everyday comfort and support. Adjustable lumbar support and a headrest pillow help support your back and neck during longer gaming or computer sessions, while adjustable seat height lets you find a comfortable position for your setup. This model features a rocking tilt function rather than a multi-position locking recliner. Release the tilt control to rock back and forth when you want to relax, then return to a stable upright position when it is time to focus. A heavy-duty metal base supports up to 250 lb, while the 360-degree swivel and smooth-rolling nylon casters provide convenient movement around your gaming setup. The PU leather surface is easy to wipe clean for everyday use. All required hardware and tools are included, with straightforward instructions for assembly in approximately 10–15 minutes.
